verdict.rationale: The docs name a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and an asynchronous screening mode for high-volume scenarios. Exports can also pull whole datasets (customers, cases, transactions) by date range. Beyond that, the evidence is thin: the batch API gets one sentence, and monitoring status and configuration endpoints are explicitly single-customer. Missing for 10: documented batch API details (payload, limits, supported operations), bulk case/alert remediation or bulk monitoring changes, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
